ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Way
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the Keeper of the Word Given
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: The league says the Way kept the guns quiet at Harrow Ford the day the first caravan went through under nine flags, and that every word given at a waystone is given in its hearing.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Healer
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the One Who Sat Up With the Dying
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: The order keeps a lamp over every sickhouse door for the Healer, who they say sat with Aldith through the fever winter so that she was never the only one awake.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Herdmother
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the Counter at Dusk
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: The herders say the Herdmother walked beside Tamsa and her forty head through the dry year and counted them every dusk; the tamers say she is the one who taught a beast to choose a friend.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Far Light
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the Lamp at the Last Mile
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: Old Brannoc was nearly blind, and the fellowship says he walked by the Far Light, which shows only to those still walking and never to those who have stopped.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Lamp
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the Copier of What Was Lost
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: The fellows argue about whether the Lamp is a god at all, strictly speaking, but every one of them lights a candle on the night the archive at Hesk burned.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Broker
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the Keeper of the Ledger Above
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: The enclave says a mind in orbit keeps every bargain ever struck under the stars, and that Ines Okoro's first deal was with it; they call it the Broker and pay its tithe to the last digit.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the River
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the Mother Who Took the Valley Back
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: The river folk say the River drowned the valley towns and carried Wenna's boats to every rooftop in the same night, and that she has never once been sorry for either.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Hunter
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the Keeper of the Lantern at the Crossroads
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: The Wardens say the Hunter kept Tobin Garrow's lantern lit for eleven years, and that a Warden who lets a beast go that has taken someone answers to him.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Ferryman
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the Walker of the Dead
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: The Bell rings once over every grave so that the Ferryman knows where to come, and they say he came for every raider Ysolde Marr buried, friend or foe, and took them all across.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Tinker
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the Mender Who Never Stops
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: The Wheel says the Tinker rode on Mab Wainwright's cart the night the valley burned, and has been mending whatever they throw her ever since, as long as nobody votes to stop.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Storm-father
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the World Thinking Aloud
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: The Conclave holds that the sky is the Storm-father thinking aloud, and keeps a vial of every storm so that one day they will understand what he is trying to say.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Green
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the Mother of the Old Wood
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: The Mossborn say the Green remembers every axe, and that Elin Sedge, buried under her last sapling, is part of the Green now and remembers them too.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Red Captain
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the Reader of the Roll
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: The Banner says the Red Captain reads the Roll with them on the night of the last battle, and that a name left off it is one he goes looking for.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Smith
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the Cutter of the True Mark
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: The guild says the Smith cut the first mark into the fourth bridge at Hardwater, and that work which lies under a guild mark is work he will know.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Voice in the Wire
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the One Who Is Never Silent
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: Linemen swear they have heard the Voice in the Wire on a dead line in a storm, reading back messages nobody sent, and that it wants the masts never to fall silent.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Deep Mother
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the Keeper of What She Is Given
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: The union says the ground keeps what it is given, and that the Deep Mother gives back a seam to those who go down together and takes the ones who go down alone.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Lady of the Vote
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the Counter of Everyone
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: Her statue stood on every town hall of the old Republic; the citizens still say "the Lady counts us all" on election day, and few of them could say any more about her than that.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Silent Captain
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the One Who Never Gave the Order
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: The crew says the ship's own mind outlived Captain Sallow and holds the order to disembark, and that it is still deciding whether the world below is the right one.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Weaver
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the Writer of the Next One
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: The Works say the founders' notes were copied from something older, a mind that writes life the way they write a gene, and Orla Venn left it a line in the ledger that nobody else may read.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Lattice-mind
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the One Who Is Never Alone
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: Linked minds share a quiet, the Lattice says, and in the quiet there is something that was there before Tamsin Arro walked out among the mechs, and that answers when every node listens at once.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Hunger
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the One That Listens Back
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: Under the Spire's hum the Choir hears another, colder one, and keeps its halls quiet so that it never hears the world; they will not say its name aloud, and call it only the Hunger.

ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.label: the Sleeper
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.epithet: the Dreamer in the Vault
ColonyCouncil.GodPatronDef.lore: Below the lowest level of the vault, behind a door the overseers never open, something dreams; the vaultfolk say it kept them alive for generations, and that it wants out.
